dataFlows.transformKql:
source
          | where schemaVersion == "1.0.0"
          | project
              TimeGenerated = timeGenerated,
              EventId = substring(tostring(eventId), 0, 128),
              EventOriginalId = substring(tostring(eventOriginalId), 0, 256),
              EventCategory = substring(tostring(eventCategory), 0, 128),
              EventType = substring(tostring(eventType), 0, 128),
              EventAction = substring(tostring(eventAction), 0, 128),
              EventResult = substring(tostring(eventResult), 0, 32),
              EventSeverity = substring(tostring(eventSeverity), 0, 32),
              ApplicationName = substring(tostring(application.name), 0, 128),
              ApplicationEnvironment = substring(tostring(application.environment), 0, 64),
              ActorUserId = substring(tostring(actor.userId), 0, 256),
              ActorUsername = substring(tostring(actor.username), 0, 256),
              SourceIpAddress = substring(tostring(source.ipAddress), 0, 64),
              CorrelationId = substring(tostring(request.correlationId), 0, 256),
              PolicyId = substring(tostring(security.policyId), 0, 128),
              PolicyVersion = substring(tostring(security.policyVersion), 0, 32),
              PolicyHash = substring(tostring(security.policyHash), 0, 128),
              ValueScore = toint(security.valueScore),
              CollectorId = substring(tostring(collector.id), 0, 128),
              PrivacyDetected = privacy.detected,
              Labels = labels,
              RawEnvelope = pack_all(),
              TimeObserved = timeObserved,
              EventOutcomeReason = substring(tostring(eventOutcomeReason), 0, 1024),
              Target = target,
              Change = change,
              Attributes = attributes,
              Origin = collector.origin

metadata.description: Existing Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel and BowerSecurity_CL.
Create the rules enabled. Keep false until the rules are validated against this workspace.
Minutes between scheduled runs. Shorter runs alert sooner and cost more queries.
Minutes after ingestion before a row is evaluated, so it is queryable when the run reads it.

Minutes of first-ingestion history re-checked for crossings that a missed or late run did not alert. Must be at least (alertVisibilityRuns + 1) x frequencyMinutes, or no retry slot exists; deployment fails otherwise.

Runs after which a rule run's alerts are queryable in SecurityAlert. A missed crossing is retried only every this many runs, so a retry never runs before the previous attempt's alert is visible. Raise it if SecurityAlert ingestion is slower than (alertVisibilityRuns - 1) x frequencyMinutes; too low a value can raise a second alert (grouping still keeps one incident).

Scopes detection keys and rule names to this deployment. Use a distinct value for each deployment of this content in one workspace, so they never suppress each other's alerts. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
Minutes between runs of the beyond-tolerance monitor; each run evaluates exactly the first ingestions of the last interval.
Longest delay between event time and first ingestion that the rules evaluate (outage SLO plus drain). Azure Monitor rewrites event times older than two days.
Event-time bucket for threshold counting.
Distinct failed network logons from one address in one bucket that raise an alert.
Distinct firewall denials from one address in one bucket that raise an alert.
Alerts for the same IP entity within this duration join one incident.
Reopen a closed matching incident instead of creating a new one. Unavailable in the Defender portal.

variables.catchUpMinutesChecked: [if(greaterOrEquals(parameters('catchUpMinutes'), mul(add(parameters('alertVisibilityRuns'), 1), parameters('frequencyMinutes'))), parameters('catchUpMinutes'), fail('catchUpMinutes must be at least (alertVisibilityRuns + 1) x frequencyMinutes, or missed crossings are never retried.'))]

variables.firewallQuery: [__bicep.tune(variables('$fxv#3'), 'bower-firewall-deny', parameters('detectionKeyScope'), 20, parameters('firewallDenyThreshold'), parameters('frequencyMinutes'), parameters('settleDelayMinutes'), variables('catchUpMinutesChecked'), parameters('maxIngestionDelayMinutes'), parameters('bucketMinutes'), parameters('alertVisibilityRuns'))]
variables.toleranceQuery: [replace(replace(replace(variables('$fxv#4'), 'let maxDelay = 360m;', format('let maxDelay = {0}m;', parameters('maxIngestionDelayMinutes'))), 'let settleDelay = 5m;', format('let settleDelay = {0}m;', parameters('settleDelayMinutes'))), 'let frequency = 60m;', format('let frequency = {0}m;', parameters('toleranceFrequencyMinutes')))]

metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace (Microsoft Sentinel enabled) name in this resource group.
Create the rules enabled. Default false: validate against the tenant first.
How often each rule runs (Sentinel minimum is five minutes).
Look-back for both rules. Sentinel requires a frequency of at least one hour once the look-back reaches two days.
Collector IDs that must keep sending health records; they alert even if never seen in the look-back.
Minutes without a newly ingested collector_health record before a collector is reported missing.
Default minutes without new security events from a collector and application/environment.
Per-source silence allowances: [{ application, environment, maximumSilenceMinutes }].
